Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: GLS Gdańsk III 2026
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

This competition serves as the sequel to **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and will feature **Clock** as the main event. Additional official events include **3×3, Megaminx, Skewb, 3x3 One-Handed (OH), 3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC), and 5×5 Blindfolded (5BLD)**. The competition will also include the unofficial event **3×3 Team Blindfolded**. Participation in unofficial events is entirely optional and will not affect official competition results. Additional unofficial events, including **1×3×3 Floppy Cube** and **Magic**, are **tentative** and may be added depending on schedule availability and logistical considerations. Please refer to the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026#72726-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for further details. All competitors and guests are encouraged to carefully review the information tabs on this page for details regarding the **competition schedule, event regulations, venue guidelines, and registration procedures**. Familiarizing yourself with this information will help ensure the competition runs smoothly and that all participants have an enjoyable experience. We look forward to seeing you at **Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026**.

venue.name: Langenstein Stockhalle
venue.details: Follow the signs to the venue

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: ### Português **Atencão:** Chegamos ao limite de inscrições, isso significa que novas inscrições serão aceitas **somente caso haja alguma desistência**. Neste caso, entraremos em contato com todos os inscritos não confirmados via e-mail, daremos um período para que respondam manifestando interesse, e aprovaremos as inscrições pela ordem que foram feitas, mediante pagamento da taxa de inscrição (R$20). Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa. #### Utilização de imagem Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso. ### English: **Attention:** We have reached the competitor limit, which means that new registrations will only be accepted **if there is a cancellation**. In that case, we'll reach out to all not confirmed registered competitors through email. We'll give a time window answer, saying they're still interested in participating, and we'll approve the registrations in the order they happened, after paying the registration fee (R$20). This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** so your spot can be given to someone else. #### Image use It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

items.name: Teknostallen 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Teknostallen 2026 Gjør deg klar for en fin kubehelg når vi inviterer til konkurranse i Teknostallen i Trondheim 28.–29. mars! Dette blir en helg med ekte konkurransestemning, offisielle tider og masse energi. Arrangementet er for ALLE – enten du løser kuben på 3 sekunder eller 3 minutter, og enten du er 7 eller 70 år. Her skal både nybegynnere og erfarne speedcubers samles for å dele lidenskapen for kuben og jakten på nye personlige rekorder. Konkurransen går over to dager inne i den spektakulære tropiske hagen i Teknostallen, en helt unik ramme for raske fingre og raske hoder. Det konkurreres i mange ulike grener, fra klassisk 3x3 til flere andre varianter. Dette blir en helg fylt med mestring, spenning og ekte kubeglede. Man går inn hovedinngangen på Teknostallen, og venteområdet kommer til å være under messaninen, mens konkurransene foregår oppe på messaninen. Det er gode muligheter for å kjøpe både mat og drikke fra de ulike plassene på bygget som Mellom, Glød og Snurr. --- ### 🇺🇸 Teknostallen 2026 Get ready for a great cube weekend as we invite you to a competition at Teknostallen in Trondheim on March 28–29. This will be a weekend filled with real competition atmosphere, official timing and plenty of energy. The event is for EVERYONE – whether you solve the cube in 3 seconds or 3 minutes, and whether you are 7 or 70 years old. Both beginners and experienced speedcubers will gather to share their passion for cubing and the pursuit of new personal bests. The competition takes place over two days inside the spectacular tropical garden at Teknostallen, a truly unique setting for fast fingers and fast minds. Multiple events will be held, from the classic 3x3 to several other variations. Expect a weekend filled with achievement, excitement and true cube joy. Enter through the main entrance of Teknostallen. The waiting area will be located under the mezzanine, while the competitions take place on the mezzanine level. There will be great opportunities to purchase food and drinks from the various venues in the building, including Mellom, Glød and Snurr.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2026#70615-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- **🇺🇸 English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ## Please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69106-favorites-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab before registering. If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69086-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AnsanFavorites2026#69085-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

Every tenth matters, every hundredth defines. 3 rounds of the fastest events. The greatest challenge: **beat the clock**. ​ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the **Municipality of San Andrés Cholula** and **Municipal President Guadalupe Cuautle Torres**. ​ Contrarreloj - San Andrés Cholula 2026 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations). **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing, Team Puebla and the organization team for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Winter 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Julian Ostdal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl und Sebastian Feichtinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Winter 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Julian Ostadal, Noah Kirrane, Simon Praschl and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$35. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimOpen2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$35. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1NTU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3a118b424e278701313a1719599eeb8de50cc7ef/Screenshot_2025-10-20_at_8.56.54_PM.png) ### **대한민국 국적이 아닌 선수분들께서는 Korean Championship 2025에 참가 신청을 삼가주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.** Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 열리는 가장 중요한 WCA 대회입니다. 본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적자에게 주어지기를 희망합니다. 다른 대회에는 언제든지 참가를 환영합니다. 모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 참가자를 위해 결승 라운드 참가 인원의 50% 또는 8명 중 더 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다. 우선 배정이 적용되는 라운드에서는, 이전 라운드에서 진출하는 참가자 중 대한민국 참가자가 먼저 선발되며, 이후 다른 국적의 상위 참가자가 선발됩니다. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. --- ### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2025.** Korean Championship is the most important WCA competition in Korea. As this competition is held to determine the national champion, we hope that the championship title will be awarded to competitors with Korean nationality. You are always welcome to participate in other competitions. For the final round of all events, 50% or up to 8 of the finalist spots (whichever is smaller) will be reserved for competitors representing the Republic of Korea. In rounds with reserved spots, advancing competitors will first include the top Korean competitors from the previous round, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). According to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties upon request from the organizers.

items.name: Frost-Free Favorites AZ 2025
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67008-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ### Please note that this is a "Favorites" style competition Since this is a "Favorites" competition, you may choose at most **five (5) events**. If you are unfamiliar with this style of a competition, please read the "[What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FrostFreeFavoritesAZ2025#67007-what-is-a-favorites-competition)" tab. Due to the style of this competition, the schedule may change after registration has closed to allot the appropriate amount of time to each event based on registration numbers. Due to scheduling so many events, we have a few events that overlap. You can still register to compete in both events; you will just do one event's solves and upon finishing, compete in the other event. ### Please note that competitors are limited to 1 guest each. This is due to venue space and limited seating available. ### Connect with the Arizona cubing community! Instagram: [@arizonacubing](https://www.instagram.com/arizonacubing/) Facebook Group: [Arizona Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/arizonacubing)

As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pelo site da WCA, mediante pagamento antecipado da taxa via PIX. A inscrição será confirmada apenas após a validação do pagamento. Para garantir o bom andamento do evento, ao se inscrever em uma modalidade você também assume o compromisso de atuar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria, conforme estabelecido pelas regras da WCA. Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, com as responsabilidades divididas entre todos os competidores. Em cada modalidade haverá, no mínimo, dois grupos: em um deles você competirá e, no outro, ajudará como juiz ou embaralhador. Ao efetuar sua inscrição, você autoriza a AACM, a WCA e seus parceiros a utilizarem gratuitamente sua imagem em fotos e filmagens realizadas durante o evento, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 **English:** The competition is open to participants of all ages. Registrations must be made exclusively through the WCA website, with the entry fee paid in advance via PIX. Registration will only be confirmed after payment validation. To ensure the smooth running of the event, by registering for an event you also commit to serving as a judge or scrambler in that category, as established by the WCA regulations. In this way, the competition becomes self-sustainable, with responsibilities shared among all competitors. For each event, there will be at least two groups: in one you will compete, and in the other you will serve as a judge or scrambler. By completing your registration, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to freely use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, including for commercial purposes.
